notes: Dining table: types drop-leaf/extending/pedestal/trestle/refectory kept as t; six archetypes (Tulip table/Knoll, refectory, trestle, Shaker trestle, Ming painting table, Nakashima slab). Gateleg: Jacobean/English period archetype plus IKEA NORDEN and VIHALS kept as mass-market models (old duplicate VIHALS range dropped). Bar table and kitchen island kept without models (restraint); kitchen island limited to freestanding. Left out: Tulip table sizes and oval/laminate options (only in search snippets), Nakashima named tables (Conoid etc.) and a dated Nakashima trestle table (not confirmed on a retrieved page), other Ming forms (altar, square, kang tables; not on retrieved pages).
